title: With no erase kept, a record adopts whatever erase it is at when it first opens: a fallback first load right after a connect keeps no key, so the cloud's first open adopts the erase made in between, and drafts typed before it stay (also a switch away and back across an erase)
evidence: Lead A11, 2026-11-12. packages/health-core/src/record-host.ts clearedAtOpen (no key adopts; fallback keeps none); widget-src/standalone/connect.ts forgetClearedErase. Pinned by record-session.clear-owed.test.ts (the fallback test; case 5) and web-record-host.cleared-erase.test.ts. Smallest fix not built: a switch-away clears the off-file data it leaves behind
